Bir Shreshtha Captain Mohiuddin Jahangir in the eyes of his comrades
2021-12-14T23:01:00+06:00 | Star Special
https://www.thedailystar.net/star-multimedia/news-multimedia/news/bir-shreshtha-captain-mohiuddin-jahangir-the-eyes-his-comrades-2917626

Today is the 50th anniversary of Bir Shreshtha Captain Mohiuddin Jahangir's martyrdom. He was martyred on December 14, 1971 during a frontline battle in Chapainawabganj. His comrades still bear the tragedy of his death only two days before the liberation.
